reference_sql:
WITH latest AS (  -- one row per product with a price version
  SELECT product_id, MAX(valid_from) AS valid_from
  FROM price_history
  GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT ph.product_id, ph.valid_from, ph.list_price_eur
FROM price_history ph
JOIN latest l ON l.product_id = ph.product_id AND l.valid_from = ph.valid_from
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ph.product_id
JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
WHERE c.category_name = 'Headphones'
alternatives:
SELECT ph.product_id, ph.valid_from, ph.list_price_eur
FROM price_history ph
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ph.product_id
JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
WHERE c.category_name = 'Headphones'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM price_history ph2
                  WHERE ph2.product_id = ph.product_id AND ph2.valid_from > ph.valid_from)

SELECT ph.product_id, ph.valid_from, ph.list_price_eur
FROM price_history ph
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ph.product_id
JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
WHERE c.category_name = 'Headphones'
  AND ph.valid_from = (SELECT MAX(ph2.valid_from) FROM price_history ph2 WHERE ph2.product_id = ph.product_id)

other_way.sql:
SELECT ph.product_id, ph.valid_from, ph.list_price_eur
FROM price_history ph
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ph.product_id
JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
WHERE c.category_name = 'Headphones'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM price_history ph2
                  WHERE ph2.product_id = ph.product_id AND ph2.valid_from > ph.valid_from)
other_way.tradeoff: NOT EXISTS keeps the version with no later one, which reads well on every engine, but checks every pair of versions.
